blockers: Data race on m_currentFrameCount in qttunebridge.cpp:78 and qttunebridge.h:156 - the member is incremented in handleFrameInternal (GUI thread) and read in onFrame (worker thread) without synchronization, violating thread safety requirements

Missing beginInsertRows/endInsertRows pair in FrameListModel::appendFrame (qttunebridge.cpp:53-66) - insertion notification is emitted before capacity eviction, causing potential view/model index corruption
questions: What is the intended backpressure semantics: should frames be dropped at source (onFrame) or at the model layer (appendFrame eviction)? The implementation does both with inconsistent logic
Is the removal of SignalListModel intentional for v0.3.0, or is this incomplete refactoring that leaves the signal display functionality broken?
Should m_currentFrameCount track processed frames or model size? The current logic conflates these metrics
nits: Consider adding a comment explaining why FrameListModel::appendFrame emits countChanged after eviction rather than using the model's row count directly
The comment in qttunebridge.h about 'anonymous structs' should clarify whether qttune_frame_t can be forward-declared as an opaque type
Removed code had proper beginRemoveRows/endRemoveRows pairing for in-flight frame tracking; new code lacks equivalent synchronization for model modifications
